source.publication: 2025 MI-1040 Forms and Instructions (includes Form 4884 instructions)
source.section: Schedule 1 line 11 (PDF page 14: military retirement benefits due to service in the U.S. Armed Forces or Michigan National Guard); MI-1040 lines 9a, 10, 13-17 (PDF page 10 Line 9a, Line 10, Line 17; PDF page 11 example: line 14 income subject to tax less line 15 exemptions = line 16 taxable income)

worked: Federal AGI = military retirement 30,000.00 + wages 40,000.00 = 70,000.00. Federal taxable income = 70,000.00 - federal standard deduction (15,750.00) = 54,250.00; given, not tested; the federal senior deduction is ignored. Michigan: Schedule 1 line 11 U.S. Armed Forces retirement 30,000.00 subtracted in full at any age (the wages are civilian pay, taxed). Line 14 = 70,000.00 - 30,000.00 = 40,000.00; exemption 5,800.00; line 16 = 34,200.00. MI-1040 line 17 tax = 34,200.00 x 0.0425 = 1,453.50. No credits; state income tax 1,453.50.
